title: Zinc selenide engineered nanostructures: insights into modification strategies, and multifunctional applications in environmental remediation, gas sensing, energy storage, and antimicrobial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50270-50323
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07718D, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruhit Kumar Paul, Saptarshi Roy, Md Ahmaruzzaman
This review outlines ZnSe as versatile material, where tunable properties and engineered heterojunctions enable efficient photocatalysis, pollutant detoxification, antimicrobial activity, gas-sensing and energy storage performance.
